text:
sophia: Heads-up — planning staged exposure for model-v9 next week. Thinking region-first (EU then NA) + percent drip per region. Need quick OK on guardrails and rollout window.

kai: +1. propose initial slices: EU 3% -> 10% -> 25% over 48h, NA 1% -> 5% -> 15% after EU looks good.

archie: sounds good. suggest SLO + metric gates: 95th p99 latency spike >200ms or error rate >0.7% -> pause and auto-rollback to v8.

mohit: want to add quality gating: BLEU/semantic-similarity drift on our eval set. if automated eval delta >3% absolute -> hold.

infra-bot: deploy job scheduled: `deploy/model-v9/staged-exposure` queued for 2026-03-24T02:00Z. Canary flag created: `feature:model_v9_exposure`

sophia: thanks infra-bot. @kai @archie how do we want to scope audience shards? cookie-based hashing or header-based routing?

kai: header-based so internal services can opt-out via X-Redwood-Test header. cookie hashing causes sticky warm-ups on old nodes.

archie: agree header-based. we should also exclude traffic from edgeless-bench and internal test accounts (segment list: QA,INTERNAL).

mohit: adding automated monitors in observability:
```
- metric: request.latency.p99
  threshold: 200 # ms
- metric: request.errors.rate
  threshold: 0.007 # 0.7%
- metric: eval.semantic_drift
  threshold: 0.03 # 3%
```

oncall-metrics: we'll wire those into the alerting runbook. question: rollback cadence — do we instant rollback or pause and investigate?

kai: auto-pause on first threshold breach, then 10m stabilization window; if breach persists after 10m -> auto-rollback to pinned model v8. Keep manual override for SRE.

archie: config snippet for flag rules (for the ops config repo):
```
flag: model_v9_exposure
rules:
  - audience: eu_users
    pct: 3
    wait: 8h
  - audience: eu_users
    pct: 10
    wait: 24h
  - audience: eu_users
    pct: 25
    wait: 16h
  - audience: na_users
    pct: 1
    wait: 48h
  - audience: na_users
    pct: 5
    wait: 24h
```

sophia: nice. let's ensure routing fallback: if v9 fails to start or OOMs, route to v8 immediately. Also add a throttling cap: no more than +20% QPS per pool during each step to avoid hotspotting.

mohit: noted — I'll add autoscale guard: max_burst_pct: 20 and add a circuit-breaker that prevents more than 2 consecutive upsizes in 1h.

kai: I'll create the rollout PR with the flag JSON and the k8s rollout annotations. tag me for review.

sophia: timeline: PR today, deploy job Tue 02:00Z, start EU step Tue 02:00Z->Wed 02:00Z, NA starts Wed 08:00Z. All watchers please review runbook and QA list.

archie: quick QA checklist:
- confirm weighted routing hash stable across restarts
- smoke-test common prompts (auth, summarization, embeddings)
- validate KV-cache hit rates unchanged
- confirm telemetry labels: model_version, region_slice, exposure_pct

sophia: everyone ping here when PR is up. tag @oncall-metrics to confirm dashboards wired. :white_check_mark:

kai: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/model-rollouts/pulls/92 — includes runbook and flag. cc @mohit @archie

mohit: review done, lgtm. I'll land monitoring patches after PR merges.

sophia: awesome. moving to follow-up channel for post-deploy notes. thanks team. :tada:
